cases.name: Savannah Keaton
cases.about: On her Go Fund Me, her sister wrote: "She was a devoted friend, a beloved daughter, and a loving mother. Savannah meant the world to our family and to everyone who knew her. Her kindness, warmth, and strength touched so many lives, and her absence leaves a hole in our hearts that can never be filled."
cases.narrative: He allegedly told police he shot and killed her with a shotgun after an argument.
